articles.summary: CNW Group: TD Bank Group Announces Election of Directors. articles.title: Toronto-Dominion Joins SAIL To Shape AI Patents And Banking Future
articles.mainIdea: Toronto-Dominion Joins SAIL To Shape AI Patents And Banking Future
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Toronto-Dominion Joins SAIL To Shape AI Patents And Banking Future. Toronto-Dominion Bank (TSX:TD) has joined the Shared AI License Foundation (SAIL) as a founding observer. SAIL is a cross-industry initiative focused on collaborative patent licensing for artificial intelligence technologies. TD is participating alongside global technology and financial firms to help shape approaches to AI intellectual property.
